csv_scope_of_work: Cumberland County (the County ) is soliciting statements of qualifications from experienced and qualified vendors to inspect, evaluate, collect and report on the overall condition of County facilities to include interior, mechanical, electrical, roofing, envelope and structure of buildings, and ADA accommodations. The Facility Condition Assessment (FCA) will include 40 County facilities, which vary in age, size, and use. Cumberland County is seeking a qualified vendor to provide detailed, non-destructive visual inspections for all 40 owned structures and to develop a comprehensive facility assessment, to include building condition and utilization. The selected vendor will utilize this information to develop a strategic, multi-year capital improvement plan for all buildings. The assessment shall include a comprehensive evaluation of structural components, interior elements and all critical mechanical and electrical systems across designated facilities.

title: Facility Condition Assessment & Improvement Plan
short_description: Assessment of 40 county buildings to prepare a multi-year capital improvement plan.
project_scope: Non-destructive visual inspection, evaluation, and reporting for 40 county-owned facilities of varying age, size, and use. Scope includes assessment of interior elements, structural components, roofing, building envelope, mechanical and electrical systems, ADA accommodations, and building utilization, leading to a comprehensive facility condition assessment and multi-year capital improvement plan.
services: Facility condition assessment; inspection services; cost estimating; structural engineering input; evaluation and reporting on building condition and utilization; development of a strategic multi-year capital improvement plan.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a facility condition assessment and capital planning assignment, not a design project.
- Focus is on inspection, evaluation, and reporting rather than structural concept design or engineering of new structures.
- Covers general county buildings without indication of large-span, architecturally demanding, or innovative structures.
- Includes structural engineering as one discipline, but only as part of a broad building assessment scope.
- Project type aligns poorly with sbp priorities and resembles consulting/assessment work rather than core structural design opportunities.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The documents describe assessment of 40 existing county facilities and preparation of a multi-year capital improvement plan, but provide no facility areas, replacement values, or planned intervention scope from which a reliable construction cost estimate could be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. As this is an RFQ/RFP for assessment and planning services across 40 facilities, any fee estimate would be highly speculative without building sizes, deliverables, staffing assumptions, or contract value.
references_qualifications: Experienced and qualified vendors are sought to inspect, evaluate, collect, and report on county facilities. Disciplines requested include cost estimating, inspection services, and structural engineering.
